instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Insert a single row with guest='John'
output: INSERT INTO reservations (guest, room) VALUES ('John', 100);

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Insert multiple rows at once
output: INSERT INTO reservations (guest, room) VALUES ('John', 1), ('Jane', 2), ('Jim', 3);

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Insert into reservations from a select that filters nights
output: INSERT INTO reservations (guest, room) SELECT guest, room FROM reservations_src WHERE nights = 'x';

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Update the row with id=7
output: UPDATE reservations SET guest = 'NewName' WHERE id = 7;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Update all rows setting room to 0
output: UPDATE reservations SET room = 0;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Update reservations increasing all room by 10%
output: UPDATE reservations SET room = room * 1.1;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Update rows where nights equals 'done'
output: UPDATE reservations SET guest = 'Finished' WHERE nights = 'done';

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Delete a row by id 12
output: DELETE FROM reservations WHERE id = 12;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Delete rows where room is below 50
output: DELETE FROM reservations WHERE room < 50;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Delete rows where nights is NULL
output: DELETE FROM reservations WHERE nights IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Delete all rows from reservations
output: DELETE FROM reservations;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Upsert: insert or update on conflict of the id
output: INSERT INTO reservations (id, guest) VALUES (1, 'X') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET guest = EXCLUDED.guest;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Conditional update using CASE
output: UPDATE reservations SET room = CASE WHEN room > 100 THEN room - 10 ELSE room + 10 END;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Update a join-based target using a subquery value
output: UPDATE reservations SET room = (SELECT MAX(room) FROM reservations) WHERE room IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Delete with a subquery filter
output: DELETE FROM reservations WHERE room IN (SELECT room FROM reservations WHERE nights = 'skip');

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Insert with explicit column list and defaults
output: INSERT INTO reservations (guest, room, nights) VALUES ('A', 5, 'active');

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Update with a LIMIT to only change a few rows
output: UPDATE reservations SET room = room + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM reservations LIMIT 5);

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Insert ignoring duplicates
output: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reservations (guest) VALUES ('Dup');

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Delete a range where room between two values
output: DELETE FROM reservations WHERE room BETWEEN 20 AND 30;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Update setting multiple columns
output: UPDATE reservations SET guest = 'Z', room = 0, nights = NULL WHERE id = 9;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Insert a row returning its id
output: INSERT INTO reservations (guest) VALUES ('Ret') RETURNING id;

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Replace all occurrences in a string column
output: UPDATE reservations SET nights = REPLACE(nights, 'a', 'b');

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Trim whitespace then update guest
output: UPDATE reservations SET guest = TRIM(guest);

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Lowercase a text column in place
output: UPDATE reservations SET guest = LOWER(guest);

instruction:
Schema: reservations(id, guest, room, nights)
Bulk upsert with multiple rows
output: INSERT INTO reservations (id, guest) VALUES (1, 'A'), (2, 'B') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET guest = EXCLUDED.guest;
